'''Kanupian''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]]. It had distinctive rolling hills and contained [[Jualya Village]], where the renowned [[light sculptor]] [[Ves Volette]] grew up.<ref name="sos">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>
